اقتضبوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَبُوا (iqtaḍabū) /iq.ta.dˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اُقْتُضِبُوا (uqtuḍibū) /uq.tu.dˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اِقْتَضِبُوا (iqtaḍibū) /iq.ta.dˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
